addr: 2nd Floor, 2082, 24th Main Rd, Vanganahalli, 1st Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Enjoyed the new festive perpermint mocha. Gagana was too kind to guide us  for using the app and getting the best offer. I can surely vouch for the ambience, this is our new hangout place.

Tried veg paneer tikka sandwich. It was good.

Easy to reach just that parking space is limited. You need to park a little far. Place is big enough to accommodate 30-35 couples/families

took my father to Third Wave Coffee, a place known for its diverse range of coffees and food offerings. What's intriguing is that this place is consistently bustling with people. The comfortable and uncomplicated seating arrangements add to the cool and cozy ambiance of the place.
